gallery.title: File:Mount Cargill.jpg
gallery.credit: Image was created by me using a Canon PowerShot G3 (reference, Panorama 2118-2127 B; shutter 1/500 s, aperture F4.0, and ISO Auto (maybe 50)).
gallery.description: This is a panorama of the view from the summit of Mount Cargill near Dunedin, in New Zealand. The base of a television mast can be seen on the left, with the Dunedin harbour and the peninsula beyond. Dunedin city centre can be seen in the centre, and Blueskin Bay is at the far right. Location is S 45°48.783' E 170°33.218' (WGS '84; within 5 m).
gallery.dateCreated: Images created 28 November 2003 (5:53-5:55 pm; stitched 2 February 2005).

gallery.title: File:Flagstaff Hill.jpg
gallery.credit: Image was created by me using a Canon PowerShot G3 (reference, Panorama 2339-2352 B; shutter 1/800 s, aperture F4.0, and ISO Auto (maybe 50)).
gallery.description: This is a panorama of the view from the summit of Flagstaff Hill near Dunedin, in New Zealand. Mosgiel can be seen on the left, and Dunedin on the right. Mount Cargill is slightly right of centre. Location is S 45°49.958' E 170°27.979' (WGS '84; within 5 m).
gallery.dateCreated: Images created 1 December 2003 (3:48-3:50 pm; stitched 10 May 2005).

gallery.title: File:Mount Cargill 2.jpg
gallery.credit: Image was created by me using a Canon PowerShot G3 (reference, Panorama 2130-2140; shutter 1/640 s, aperture F4.0, and ISO Auto (maybe 50)).
gallery.description: This is a panorama of the view from just east of the summit of Mount Cargill near Dunedin, in New Zealand. The base of a television mast can be seen at the extreme left and right edges, with Blueskin Bay on the centre left. Dunedin harbour runs from its entrance near the centre to the city centre on the right, the peninsula can be seen beyond.
gallery.dateCreated: Images created 28 November 2003 (6:05-6:07 pm; stitched 9 March 2005).
